day.headline: A Tiger day — Horse and Dog are in step.

reasons: Dog and Tiger share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Bed at nine tonight. Don't negotiate with yourself about it.

reasons: Pig pairs with Tiger — a harmonious day
signs.message: They painted over half of it. Go see the rest today.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Tiger — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Admit you don't get it. Ask the dumb question out loud.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Tiger — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: sitting down to think and not thinking
signs.message: Nothing's arriving in that chair. Think while you're moving instead.

reasons: Tiger's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: the film at the top of the list
signs.message: Start it tonight, even if you're asleep by the middle.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Tiger — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: That air means rain. Grab the jacket before you head out.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Tiger — the day is yours to steer

reasons: Horse and Tiger share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Look up what it actually means. Two minutes, then move on.

signs.message: Low-effort company tonight. Nobody has to say anything.
